name: Rafiq of the Many
description: The Bant Knight-General Elspeth served and helped kill Malfegor.

description_citations.text: "Elspeth Tirel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rafiq says even in single combat he is never alone.
timeline.quote: Even in single combat, I am never alone.

citation.text: Angelic Benediction (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rafiq says a dead man's body belongs to Bant and his soul probably to the angels.
timeline.quote: His body belongs to Bant now.

citation.text: Offering to Asha (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
timeline.quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion targets Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Alara was targeted by Elesh Norn 's Machine Legion as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Alara", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rafiq is awarded the Sigil of the Salted Wind for resolving a dispute by defeating Mubin in the arena.
timeline.quote: awarded to Rafiq for resolving a dispute between the ship patrols and the island aven by defeating Mubin in the arena

citation.text: "Bant", section "Sigils". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret warns Rafiq to employ the angels against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret sent a warning message to Rafiq

citation.text: "Bant", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malfegor is killed in Bant by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq.
timeline.quote: he attacked Bant, where he was killed by Elspeth Tirel and Rafiq

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth helps Rafiq kill Malfegor, ending Bant's part in the Conflux war.
timeline.quote: she assisted Rafiq in killing Malfegor
